definitions.explanation: Used in questions and conditional sentences to mean 'anything at all.'

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か{問題|もんだい}がありますか。
{何|なに}かあったら{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: Please contact me if anything happens.

notes:
USAGE: {何|なに}か is used to refer to an unspecified thing. It can mean "something" in statements or "anything" in questions and conditionals.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{何|なに}か{食|た}べる (to eat something)
・{何|なに}か{飲|の}む (to drink something)
・{何|なに}かあったら (if anything happens)
・{何|なに}か{用|よう}ですか (Can I help you?/Do you need something?)

RELATED WORDS:
・{何|なに}も (nothing - with negative)
・{誰|だれ}か (someone)
・どこか (somewhere)
・いつか (sometime)
